description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Leonard Williams did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Williams remains uncertain heading into Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rashid Shaheed was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Shaheed appears likely to return for the Seahawks. He'll remain a WR4/WR5 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Rashid Shaheed (knee) logs full practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Uchenna Nwosu was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nwosu appears on track to have a chance to return on Sunday against the Raiders.
items.title: Uchenna Nwosu (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Quenton Nelson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nelson's status remains uncertain heading into Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.title: Quenton Nelson (knee) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Drew Lock was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Lock remains on track to start another game for the Seahawks on Sunday against the Raiders.
items.title: Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Charles Cross did not practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: James Pearce Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pearce made his season debut last week after serving an eight-game suspension. He was limited to 15 snaps in his first game of the season.
items.title: James Pearce Jr. misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carlton Davis III has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.

items.title: Carlton Davis III (knee) ruled out for Week 10

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out for Week 10 against the Lions.
items.impact: Henderson will remain sidelined due to an illness. He holds no clear timetable to return.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 10

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stevenson came out of Week 9 battling a knee tendon issue. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) misses practice Wednesday

items.desc: A.J. Brown was limited in practice on Wednesday.

items.desc: Christian Benford was limited in practice on Wednesday.

items.title: Christian Benford (wrist) limited in practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alec Anderson was limited in practice on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens signed kicker Riley Patterson.
items.impact: Patterson gets the opportunity following a workout. He will kick for Baltimore on Monday against the Chargers.
items.title: Riley Patterson signs with Ravens

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Amik Robertson (ankle) has been cleared to play in Thursday night's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Robertson will be available to play on Thursday night, despite dealing with an ankle issue of some kind at practice throughout the week. His presence is much needed for the Commanders ahead of a divisional matchup against the Giants in primetime.
items.title: Amik Robertson (ankle) cleared to play Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alvin Kamara was not seen practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kamara usually has his practice reps managed early in the week. He should still be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.title: Alvin Kamara not seen practicing Wednesday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Colson Yankoff (knee) will be unavailable for Thursday night's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Yankoff recently suffered a knee injury and will not be available to play on Thursday night as a result. His absence may lead to slightly more work for John Bates against the Giants.
items.title: Colson Yankoff (knee) unavailable for Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hockenson appears to have suffered the injuries in Monday's loss against the Bills. He will need to be monitored in practice on a short week.
items.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jauan Jennings did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jennings missed Week 9 against the Bills. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.
items.title: Jauan Jennings (calf) misses practice Wednesday
